H01.description: RouteShorthandHook rebuilds the hook signature from Parameters<T> only, dropping the hook's `this` type, so shorthand route hooks lose their typed `this` (e.g. FastifyInstance) context.

I01.description: The addresses() return type omits socket-path strings. This looks like a long-standing declaration unrelated to this change's hook typing, and nothing shown proves the change's head introduced or touched it.

I02.description: logSerializers is missing from RouteShorthandOptions. This is a separate, pre-existing type gap that the change under review did not touch.
